parsed.answer: In the Customers API, a 404 means the customer does not exist and the Problem code is CUS-404 (message: "The customer does not exist."). In the Payments API, a 404 means the payment does not exist and the Problem code is PAY-404 (message: "The payment does not exist."). Both return the same Problem object structure (type, title, status, code, detail, optional correlationId) with content type application/problem+json; they differ only in the code value (CUS-404 vs PAY-404) and the resource referenced in the message (customer vs payment).
